PUBLIC STATIC TEST FIXTURE. This predictable certificate/key pair is copied
unchanged from Go1.26.6 src/crypto/tls/testdata/example-{cert,key}.pem, whose
contents are public Go test data under the Go BSD license. It is not a real
credential, must never be trusted by a service, and is used only to test byte
binding without generating a key, opening a listener or making a request.
Source: https://go.googlesource.com/go/+/refs/tags/go1.26.6/src/crypto/tls/testdata/
